name: cAdvisor Container Metrics (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source container resource monitoring daemon with CPU, memory, disk and network metrics, API and web UI; no license fee or software usage quota.
watch_out: Runs on your own Docker/Kubernetes host; privileged container and host filesystem mounts may be required, so restrict access and review security. Infrastructure, metrics storage, remote monitoring and network costs are not included.
